title: Nilora Estates: Luxury Real Estate Platform, Cairo
description: A full MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) platform for Nilora Estates, a private residential agency selling villas, penthouses and coastal homes across Cairo and the Egyptian coast. It has a cinematic public site plus three role-based dashboards: buyers save homes and book private viewings, agents manage their listings and leads, and admins control properties, advisors, users and content.
imageAlt: Nilora Estates real estate website homepage: Cairo skyline at sunset over the Nile at Zamalek with the headline 'Where the river meets the light.'
features: Property listings for villas, penthouses and coastal homes with neighborhood guides
User dashboard to save homes, track enquiries and request private viewings
Agent dashboard to publish and edit listings and manage client leads
Admin dashboard to manage properties, advisors, users, journal posts and site content
Role-based authentication and secure REST API
SEO-ready pages with fast, responsive, cinematic design
